title: पञ्चदशाधिकत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 315 · The teaching to Vyasa's pupils

summary.en: Vyasa's pupils, glad at his words, embrace one another, and Vyasa sets out the things that stain: the Vedas that are not recited, a brahmin who keeps no vow and the like. The son of Parashara then tells his son to study, and goes by the heavenly river.
summary.kn: ವ್ಯಾಸನ ಮಾತಿನಿಂದ ಸಂತೋಷಗೊಂಡ ಶಿಷ್ಯರು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಆಲಿಂಗಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಪಠಿಸದ ವೇದ, ವ್ರತವಿಲ್ಲದ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ಮುಂತಾದ ಕಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ವ್ಯಾಸ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪರಾಶರನ ಮಗ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಲು ಹೇಳಿ ಆಕಾಶಗಂಗೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: व्यास के वचन से प्रसन्न शिष्य एक-दूसरे को गले लगाते हैं और व्यास मलिन करने वाली बातें बताते हैं: न दुहराए वेद, व्रतहीन ब्राह्मण आदि। पराशरपुत्र फिर पुत्र से अध्ययन करने को कहकर आकाशगंगा के मार्ग से चले जाते हैं।
summary.te: వ్యాసుని మాటలకు సంతోషించిన శిష్యులు ఒకరినొకరు ఆలింగనం చేసుకుంటారు; పఠించని వేదాలు, వ్రతం లేని బ్రాహ్మణుడు వంటి మలినాలను వ్యాసుడు చెబుతాడు. పరాశర పుత్రుడు కుమారునికి అధ్యయనం చేయమని చెప్పి ఆకాశగంగ ద్వారా వెళ్తాడు.
summary.ta: வியாசரின் சொற்களால் மகிழ்ந்த சீடர்கள் ஒருவரையொருவர் தழுவ, ஓதப்படாத வேதம், விரதமற்ற அந்தணன் போன்ற கறைகளை வியாசர் கூறுகிறார். பராசரர் மகன் மகனைப் படிக்குமாறு கூறி வான்கங்கை வழியே செல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: വ്യാസന്റെ വാക്കുകളിൽ സന്തോഷിച്ച ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പരസ്പരം ആലിംഗനം ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഓതാത്ത വേദങ്ങളും വ്രതമെടുക്കാത്ത ബ്രാഹ്മണനും പോലുള്ള കളങ്കങ്ങൾ വ്യാസൻ വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു. പരാശരപുത്രൻ മകനോട് പഠിക്കാൻ പറയുന്നു, തുടർന്ന് സ്വർഗ്ഗീയ നദിയുടെ തീരത്തേക്ക് പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.315; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं व्यासशिष्या महौजसः ।
अन्योन्यं हृष्टमनसः परिषस्वजिरे तदा ॥

meaning.en: Hearing their teacher's words, Vyasa's mighty pupils, glad at heart, embraced one another then.

verses.text:
उक्ताः स्मो यद्भगवता तदात्वायतिसंहितम् ।
तन्नो मनसि संरूढं करिष्यामस्तथा च तत् ॥

meaning.en: "What the master told us concerns both the present and the future; it has taken root in our minds and we will do just so."

verses.text:
अन्योन्यं च सभाज्यैवं सुप्रीतमनसः पुनः ।
विज्ञापयन्ति स्म गुरुं पुनर्वाक्यविशारदाः ॥

meaning.en: Honoring one another thus, with delighted minds, those skilled speakers again addressed their teacher.

verses.text:
शैलादस्मान्महीं गन्तुं काङ्क्षितं नो महामुने ।
वेदाननेकधा कर्तुं यदि ते रुचितं विभो ॥

meaning.en: "Great sage, we wish to go down from this mountain to the earth, if it pleases you, lord, so that we may divide the Vedas in many ways."

verses.text:
शिष्याणां वचनं श्रुत्वा पराशरसुतः प्रभुः ।
प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his pupils' words, the lord, Parashara's son, replied with words beneficial and joined to dharma and purpose.

verses.text:
क्षितिं वा देवलोकं वा गम्यतां यदि रोचते ।
अप्रमादश्च वः कार्यो ब्रह्म हि प्रचुरच्छलम् ॥

meaning.en: "Go to the earth or the world of the gods, as you please; but you must be careful, for sacred learning is easily undone by slips."

verses.text:
तेऽनुज्ञातास्ततः सर्वे गुरुणा सत्यवादिना ।
जग्मुः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा व्यासं मूर्ध्नाभिवाद्य च ॥

meaning.en: Permitted by their truthful teacher, they all circled Vyasa, bowed their heads to him, and left.

verses.text:
अवतीर्य महीं तेऽथ चातुर्होत्रमकल्पयन् ।
संयाजयन्तो विप्रांश्च राजन्यांश्च विशस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Descending to earth, they arranged the fourfold priesthood, officiating at sacrifices for brahmins, kshatriyas, and vaishyas.

verses.text:
पूज्यमाना द्विजैर्नित्यं मोदमाना गृहे रताः ।
याजनाध्यापनरताः श्रीमन्तो लोकविश्रुताः ॥

meaning.en: Always honored by the twice-born, delighting in their homes, prosperous and renowned in the world, they were devoted to officiating and teaching.

verses.text:
अवतीर्णेषु शिष्येषु व्यासः पुत्रसहायवान् ।
तूष्णीं ध्यानपरो धीमानेकान्ते समुपाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: When his pupils had gone down, Vyasa, with only his son for company, sat silent and absorbed in meditation, alone.

verses.text:
तं ददर्शाश्रमपदे नारदः सुमहातपाः ।
अथैनमब्रवीत्काले मधुराक्षरया गिरा ॥

meaning.en: The greatly ascetic Narada saw him at the hermitage, and at the right time spoke to him in a sweet voice.

verses.text:
भो भो महर्षे वासिष्ठ ब्रह्मघोषो न वर्तते ।
एको ध्यानपरस्तूष्णीं किमास्से चिन्तयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: "Hey, great sage, descendant of Vasishtha, the chanting of the sacred word is not heard. Why do you sit silent and alone, absorbed, as if worrying?

verses.text:
ब्रह्मघोषैर्विरहितः पर्वतोऽयं न शोभते ।
रजसा तमसा चैव सोमः सोपप्लवो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Without the sound of Vedic chanting this mountain does not shine, as the moon, troubled by dust and darkness, suffers eclipse.

verses.text:
न भ्राजते यथापूर्वं निषादानामिवालयः ।
देवर्षिगणजुष्टोऽपि वेदध्वनिनिराकृतः ॥

meaning.en: It does not shine as before and is like a hunters' dwelling, though visited by divine sages, for the sound of the Veda is gone.

verses.text:
ऋषयश्च हि देवाश्च गन्धर्वाश्च महौजसः ।
विमुक्ता ब्रह्मघोषेण न भ्राजन्ते यथा पुरा ॥

meaning.en: Sages, gods, and mighty gandharvas, deprived of the chanting of the sacred word, do not shine as they used to."

verses.text:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत् ।
महर्षे यत्त्वया प्रोक्तं वेदवादविचक्षण ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Narada's words, Krishna Dvaipayana said, "Great sage, expert in Vedic discourse, what you have said

verses.text:
एतन्मनोनुकूलं मे भवानर्हति भाषितुम् ।
सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शी च सर्वत्र च कुतूहली ॥

meaning.en: is agreeable to my mind; you are fit to say it. You know all, see all, and are curious about everything.

verses.text:
त्रिषु लोकेषु यद्वृत्तं सर्वं तव मते स्थितम् ।
तदाज्ञापय विप्रर्षे ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते ॥

meaning.en: Whatever occurs in the three worlds is contained in your understanding. Command me, brahmin sage: tell me what I should do for you.

verses.text:
यन्मया समनुष्ठेयं ब्रह्मर्षे तदुदाहर ।
वियुक्तस्येह शिष्यैर्मे नातिहृष्टमिदं मनः ॥

meaning.en: Tell me, brahmin sage, what I should undertake. Parted from my pupils, my mind is not very glad."

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
अनाम्नायमला वेदा ब्राह्मणस्याव्रतं मलम् ।
मलं पृथिव्या वाहीकाः स्त्रीणां कौतूहलं मलम् ॥

meaning.en: "The Vedas are soiled by lack of recitation, a brahmin by lack of vows, the earth by the Bahlikas, and women by curiosity.

verses.text:
अधीयतां भवान्वेदान्सार्धं पुत्रेण धीमता ।
विधुन्वन्ब्रह्मघोषेण रक्षोभयकृतं तमः ॥

meaning.en: Study the Vedas along with your wise son, and with the chanting of the sacred word shake off the darkness that rakshasas' fear creates."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा व्यासः परमधर्मवित् ।
तथेत्युवाच संहृष्टो वेदाभ्यासे दृढव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Narada's words, Vyasa, who knew the highest dharma and was firm in vow for Vedic study, gladly said, "So be it."

verses.text:
शुकेन सह पुत्रेण वेदाभ्यासमथाकरोत् ।
स्वरेणोच्चैः स शैक्षेण लोकानापूरयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: With his son Shuka he began Vedic recitation, filling the worlds, as it were, with his loud phonetically correct voice.

verses.text:
तयोरभ्यसतोरेवं नानाधर्मप्रवादिनोः ।
वातोऽतिमात्रं प्रववौ समुद्रानिलवेजितः ॥

meaning.en: As the two, who spoke of many dharmas, recited thus, a wind blew exceedingly hard, stirred up from the ocean.

verses.text:
ततोऽनध्याय इति तं व्यासः पुत्रमवारयत् ।
शुको वारितमात्रस्तु कौतूहलसमन्वितः ॥

meaning.en: Then Vyasa stopped his son, saying, "It is a time for no study." Shuka, held back, was full of curiosity,

verses.text:
अपृच्छत्पितरं ब्रह्मन्कुतो वायुरभूदयम् ।
आख्यातुमर्हति भवान्वायोः सर्वं विचेष्टितम् ॥

meaning.en: and asked his father: "Brahmin, from where has this wind come? You should tell me all the workings of the wind."

verses.text:
शुकस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा व्यासः परमविस्मितः ।
अनध्यायनिमित्तेऽस्मिन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Shuka's words, Vyasa, greatly amazed, spoke these words on this occasion when study is suspended.

verses.text:
दिव्यं ते चक्षुरुत्पन्नं स्वस्थं ते निर्मलं मनः ।
तमसा रजसा चापि त्यक्तः सत्त्वे व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: "Divine vision has come to you, your mind is healthy and spotless; freed of darkness and passion, you are established in goodness.

verses.text:
आदर्शे स्वामिव छायां पश्यस्यात्मानमात्मना ।
न्यस्यात्मनि स्वयं वेदान्बुद्ध्या समनुचिन्तय ॥

meaning.en: You see yourself by yourself as you see your reflection in a mirror. Placing the Vedas within yourself, reflect on them with your understanding.

verses.text:
देवयानचरो विष्णोः पितृयानश्च तामसः ।
द्वावेतौ प्रेत्य पन्थानौ दिवं चाधश्च गच्छतः ॥

meaning.en: The path of the gods that Vishnu travels and the dark path of the ancestors are the two ways after death; they lead up to heaven and down.

verses.text:
पृथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे च यत्र संवान्ति वायवः ।
सप्तैते वायुमार्गा वै तान्निबोधानुपूर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: In the earth and the atmosphere, where winds blow, there are these seven paths of the wind. Learn them in order.

verses.text:
तत्र देवगणाः साध्याः समभूवन्महाबलाः ।
तेषामप्यभवत्पुत्रः समानो नाम दुर्जयः ॥

meaning.en: There the mighty groups of gods called Sadhyas came to be, and one of them had an unconquerable son named Samana.

verses.text:
उदानस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभूद्व्यानस्तस्याभवत्सुतः ।
अपानश्च ततो ज्ञेयः प्राणश्चापि ततः परम् ॥

meaning.en: His son was Udana, his son was Vyana; after him know Apana, and then Prana.

verses.text:
अनपत्योऽभवत्प्राणो दुर्धर्षः शत्रुतापनः ।
पृथक्कर्माणि तेषां तु प्रवक्ष्यामि यथातथम् ॥

meaning.en: Prana had no offspring, unassailable, a scorcher of foes. I will describe their separate functions as they are.

verses.text:
प्राणिनां सर्वतो वायुश्चेष्टा वर्तयते पृथक् ।
प्राणनाच्चैव भूतानां प्राण इत्यभिधीयते ॥

meaning.en: The wind in every direction sets creatures' movements going separately, and because it breathes life into beings it is called Prana.

verses.text:
प्रेरयत्यभ्रसंघातान्धूमजांश्चोष्मजांश्च यः ।
प्रथमः प्रथमे मार्गे प्रवहो नाम सोऽनिलः ॥

meaning.en: The wind that drives the masses of clouds, those born of smoke and of heat, in the first path is called Pravaha.

verses.text:
अम्बरे स्नेहमभ्रेभ्यस्तडिद्भ्यश्चोत्तमद्युतिः ।
आवहो नाम संवाति द्वितीयः श्वसनो नदन् ॥

meaning.en: The second, which blows in the sky bringing moisture to clouds and lightning with the finest radiance, roaring, is called Avaha.

verses.text:
उदयं ज्योतिषां शश्वत्सोमादीनां करोति यः ।
अन्तर्देहेषु चोदानं यं वदन्ति महर्षयः ॥

meaning.en: The one that constantly makes the heavenly lights such as the moon rise, and which the great sages call Udana within bodies, is another.

verses.text:
यश्चतुर्भ्यः समुद्रेभ्यो वायुर्धारयते जलम् ।
उद्धृत्याददते चापो जीमूतेभ्योऽम्बरेऽनिलः ॥

meaning.en: The wind that holds up water from the four oceans and, lifting it, takes the waters into the sky's clouds,

verses.text:
योऽद्भिः संयोज्य जीमूतान्पर्जन्याय प्रयच्छति ।
उद्वहो नाम वर्षिष्ठस्त्रितीयः स सदागतिः ॥

meaning.en: which joins the clouds with water and hands them to the rain god, is the third, called Udvaha, the best rainmaker, ever moving.

verses.text:
समुह्यमाना बहुधा येन नीलाः पृथग्घनाः ।
वर्षमोक्षकृतारम्भास्ते भवन्ति घनाघनाः ॥

meaning.en: By it dark, dense clouds are carried about in many ways and, starting to release rain, become thick-massed clouds.

verses.text:
संहता येन चाविद्धा भवन्ति नदतां नदाः ।
रक्षणार्थाय संभूता मेघत्वमुपयान्ति च ॥

meaning.en: By it thunderclouds are brought together and struck, born for the protection of the worlds, and they become what is called cloud.

verses.text:
योऽसौ वहति देवानां विमानानि विहायसा ।
चतुर्थः संवहो नाम वायुः स गिरिमर्दनः ॥

meaning.en: The fourth, which carries the gods' aerial chariots through the sky, is the wind called Samvaha, crusher of mountains.

verses.text:
येन वेगवता रुग्णा रूक्षेणारुजता रसान् ।
वायुना विहता मेघा न भवन्ति बलाहकाः ॥

meaning.en: By its swift, dry, harsh force, clouds are broken and shattered, and rain-bearing clouds no longer exist.

verses.text:
दारुणोत्पातसंचारो नभसः स्तनयित्नुमान् ।
पञ्चमः स महावेगो विवहो नाम मारुतः ॥

meaning.en: The fifth is the fierce-moving, mighty wind named Vivaha, which roams in terrible portents and makes the sky thunder.

verses.text:
यस्मिन्पारिप्लवे दिव्या वहन्त्यापो विहायसा ।
पुण्यं चाकाशगङ्गायास्तोयं विष्टभ्य तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: In its unsteady course the heavenly waters are carried through the sky, and the holy water of the celestial Ganga is held and stays.

verses.text:
दूरात्प्रतिहतो यस्मिन्नेकरश्मिर्दिवाकरः ।
योनिरंशुसहस्रस्य येन भाति वसुंधरा ॥

meaning.en: Where it blocks it from afar, the sun has a single ray, and by it the earth shines, which is the source of a thousand beams.

verses.text:
यस्मादाप्यायते सोमो निधिर्दिव्योऽमृतस्य च ।
षष्ठः परिवहो नाम स वायुर्जवतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: By it the moon, the divine store of nectar, is replenished: the sixth is the wind named Parivaha, best of the swift.

verses.text:
सर्वप्राणभृतां प्राणान्योऽन्तकाले निरस्यति ।
यस्य वर्त्मानुवर्तेते मृत्युवैवस्वतावुभौ ॥

meaning.en: At death it drives out the life breaths of all living beings, and both Death and Yama follow its course.

verses.text:
सम्यगन्वीक्षतां बुद्ध्या शान्तयाध्यात्मनित्यया ।
ध्यानाभ्यासाभिरामाणां योऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते ॥

meaning.en: It is what leads to immortality those who look rightly with a calm understanding ever fixed on the Self and delight in the practice of meditation.

verses.text:
यं समासाद्य वेगेन दिशामन्तं प्रपेदिरे ।
दक्षस्य दश पुत्राणां सहस्राणि प्रजापतेः ॥

meaning.en: Reaching it, the ten thousand sons of the progenitor Daksha swiftly arrived at the ends of the directions.

verses.text:
येन सृष्टः पराभूतो यात्येव न निवर्तते ।
परावहो नाम परो वायुः स दुरतिक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Whoever is created or overcome by it goes and does not return: the highest wind, called Paravaha, is hard to overcome.

verses.text:
एवमेतेऽदितेः पुत्रा मारुताः परमाद्भुताः ।
अनारमन्तः संवान्ति सर्वगाः सर्वधारिणः ॥

meaning.en: Thus these Maruts, sons of Aditi, utterly wonderful, blow without rest, going everywhere and supporting everything.

verses.text:
एतत्तु महदाश्चर्यं यदयं पर्वतोत्तमः ।
कम्पितः सहसा तेन वायुनाभिप्रवायता ॥

meaning.en: It is a great marvel that this best of mountains was suddenly shaken by this wind blowing in.

verses.text:
विष्णोर्निःश्वासवातोऽयं यदा वेगसमीरितः ।
सहसोदीर्यते तात जगत्प्रव्यथते तदा ॥

meaning.en: When Vishnu's breath-wind is stirred by force and suddenly rises, my son, the world is distressed.

verses.text:
तस्माद्ब्रह्मविदो ब्रह्म नाधीयन्तेऽतिवायति ।
वायोर्वायुभयं ह्युक्तं ब्रह्म तत्पीडितं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: Therefore knowers of Brahman do not recite the Veda when the wind blows strongly; the danger from wind is spoken of, and the sacred word would be harmed."

verses.text:
एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं पराशरसुतः प्रभुः ।
उक्त्वा पुत्रमधीष्वेति व्योमगङ्गामयात्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Having said this much, the lord, Parashara's son, told his son "Study!" and then went to the celestial Ganga.
